title: 『カレーにチョコを入れても隠し味』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Satsuki Sho draws near, Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki inform me that they won't partner run with their rival Sakura Chiyono O for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Mejiro Ardan has made up her mind. Although it may destroy her legs, she's going to shine just as bright as her sister—even if it's just for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Yaeno Muteki reflects on all the support her grandfather has given her. She's determined to repay him by showing him the extent of her growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Sakura Chiyono O is just as determined. Maruzensky was a cut above the rest, but she missed out on her opportunity to run in the Derby. Which is why…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O wants to prove Maruzensky's strength by completing her role model's dream and winning it in her stead. She swears she absolutely won't lose.
